steps.description: Registered session 1 of Set 122 (github-copilot / claude-opus-5, high).
Shipped ai_router/modules.py: create/rename/delete/assign-sets against the unchanged docs/modules.yaml contract (format-preserving splices, parse-after-write guards, ported normalization).

rename/delete refuse on a running session (incl. legacy file-presence inference); every session-state.json mutation routes through session_lifecycle.cancel_session_set, asserted behaviorally with a planted direct write as the falsifier.

_Transaction records every effect and undoes all of them; four injected-failure falsifiers (create/rename/assign-sets rollback, delete stays declared). Mutation-checked: disabling rollback fails 3 of them.

Cross-provider verification (gpt-5.5, anthropic excluded): discovery round 1 and supplementary round 2 each returned one blocking Major; remediated once; remediation-review round 3 returned VERIFIED (1 accepted, 1 accepted-with-modification). Artifacts s1-verification*.md / s1-issues*.json / s1-remediation-round-*.md. Logged retroactively at close-out.

Full pytest run of record after the last code change: 4205 passed, 9 skipped in 570.6s; recorded via run_of_record (digest 7cc75e424828). No Layer 2/3 owed - covers is by path and this session touched no extension surface. Logged retroactively at close-out.

disposition.json authored (VERIFIED, next_orchestrator, residual S122-S1-R1); lessons L-112-1 / L-064-9 cited; committed and pushed; close_session succeeded; notification fired. Logged retroactively at close-out.
Registered session 2 of Set 122 (github-copilot / claude-opus-5, high); totalSessions moved 3 -> 4 through start_session --total-sessions per the spec amendment.

Five commands now launch python -m ai_router.modules through the resolved workspace-venv interpreter (utils/routerCli.ts + moduleLifecycleCli.ts), branching on exit 3 (refused) / 4 (write failure). Deleted the TypeScript lifecycle from moduleAuthoring.ts (2601 -> 608 lines); the gitScaffold default-module scaffold is Python-backed. Residual S122-S1-R1 folded in with a mutation-checked falsifier. No command id changed.

Every router CLI run echoes the exact, copy-pasteable command line to the shared 'Dabbler Commands' output channel BEFORE spawning, then the output. One builder feeds both the echoed line and the spawned argv, so what the developer sees and what runs cannot disagree.

Removed the TypeScript session-state.json writer entirely (operator decision, journaled): added a cancel/restore CLI to ai_router/session_lifecycle.py, routed cancelLifecycleCommands.ts through it, trimmed cancelLifecycle.ts to readers (549 -> 142 lines). copyModuleDecompositionPrompt added to the module context menu. Also shipped the operator-directed start_session register-tick fix.

Cross-provider verification (gpt-5.5; anthropic excluded as the orchestrator's effective provider). Discovery round 1 fanned out 2/2 and returned two blocking Majors, both against the command-echo promise: a '> ' prompt glyph welded onto the only visible command line, and PowerShell quoting that would not run (a leading quoted exe needs '&', and '\"' is not a PowerShell escape). Supplementary round 2 found nothing new. Both remediated once, with falsifiers; remediation-review round 3 returned VERIFIED, 2 accepted / 0 rejected. Artifacts: s2-conventions.md, s2-verification*.md, s2-issues.json, s2-remediation-round-1.md.

Full pytest of record after the last code change: 4213 passed, 9 skipped in 906s. Layer 2 (npm run test:unit): 1421 passing, 2 pending. Full npm run test:playwright owed here because package.json is the extension MANIFEST (L-064-12): 20 passed / 11 failed. Eight of the eleven pass in isolation (parallel-load flake on a 4-vCPU box, confirmed spec by spec, and icon-render-mechanism additionally confirmed green at HEAD and green again after a recompile). Two were the deliberate register-tick behaviour change in work-explorer-steps.spec.ts and are updated and green. One is KNOWN-RED and operator-attested: vsix-first-run-walkthrough.spec.ts does a real network pip install, which fetches dabbler-ai-router 0.34.0 from PyPI -- a wheel that predates ai_router.modules -- so the now-Python-backed default-module scaffold cannot run on a true cold start. That is the exact regression Session 4 exists to prevent; it owns the fix and is the release gate, so neither registry publishes while it is red. All three runs recorded via run_of_record.
**Close-out.**
Registered session 3 (github-copilot / claude-opus-5, high).

MINIMUM_ROUTER_VERSION + PYPI_REQUIREMENT declared once in aiRouterInstall.ts; the install requirement and the capability precondition both derive from it (L-069-1), pinned by a test that fails if either is hard-coded. mode:install now passes --upgrade, so an existing older venv is upgraded rather than reported already-satisfied.

probeRouterCapability imports ai_router.modules with the VENV interpreter the launcher uses (L-125-1), never inferring success from pip exit codes; a failed probe flips the install outcome to ok:false with no fail-open branch. gitScaffold gates default-module creation on decideDefaultModuleScaffold (module ABSENT, not manifest provenance), which fixes retryability: a retry after a failed install now scaffolds without deleting docs/modules.yaml.

New lane npm run test:dogfood (src/test/dogfood/), 4 scenarios, real venv + real network pip, no seams: (a) clean project with no .venv finishes setup with ai_router.modules importable and the scaffold gate saying scaffold; (b) a venv holding a REAL dabbler-ai-router==0.34.0 from PyPI is upgraded past the floor, with the vacuity premise asserted first (0.34.0 must NOT provide ai_router.modules); (c) an unresolvable install attempts no Python-backed mutation and a re-run recovers with docs/modules.yaml untouched; (d) the probe answers for the venv it is given, not the host. Caught a real defect while authoring: passing a venv-shaped pythonPath made ensureVenv provision into the REPO venv, so the cold-start scenario had been passing vacuously (13s vs 38s). Fixed by resolving sys.base_prefix and asserting the venv lands under the temp project.

Cross-provider verification (gpt-5.5; anthropic excluded as the orchestrator effective provider). Discovery round 1 fanned out 2/2 and returned 4 blocking Majors reducing to 2 classes: the capability probe answered for the install venv rather than the interpreter the launchers resolve, and the dogfood asserted the GATE instead of the outcome. Supplementary round 2 added 1 more: the new CI lane depended on untracked local Python state. Remediation-review round 3 accepted 1 and REJECTED 2, catching a regression the round-1 fix introduced (the launcher interpreter was resolved eagerly, before .venv existed, which would have made the ordinary cold start report a good install as failed). Fixed by making it a thunk resolved after install, plus a mutation-checked falsifier. Round 4: VERIFIED, 5 accepted / 0 rejected, 0 findings.

All three layers run after the last code change and recorded via run_of_record. Layer 1 pytest: 4214 passed, 9 skipped in 662s (digest 1a94cea85bbf). Layer 2 mocha: 1450 passing, 2 pending in 63s (digest f440dafe1fe1). Layer 3 Playwright FULL, owed because package.json is the extension MANIFEST (L-064-12): 31/31 passed in 6.7m at 2 workers, the count CI uses per residual S122-S2-R2 - including vsix-first-run-walkthrough, which Session 2 closed out as KNOWN-RED. The first pytest attempt failed one test: the anti-resurrection guard scanned build/lib, a pip-generated copy of its own source. Fixed by excluding build/ and .eggs from the shared scan with a narrow falsifier; classified A4.2 by post_round_delta and settled by a delta-scoped remediation-review (round 5, VERIFIED).
Authoring disposition.json, committing and pushing, running close_session.
